{{Quote|Just remember, boys, ideals are nice but they don't change anything in battle. Now the quicker these dead are under the ice, the quicker we move on.|Sharp, to his men on Khorm|<ref name="The Clone Wars 7">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref>}}
'''Sharp''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who served in the [[Devil Dogs]] unit of the [[44th Special Operations Division]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Get clear, General! Let me finish this mission like a Devil Dog&mdash;with a bang|Sharp's last words|<ref name="The Clone Wars 9">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of Mimban/Legends|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], he was hit by a blaster bolt in the throat. As a result, his voice became distorted. He later participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]. During the battle, Sharp worked closely with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], whose views of upholding the ideals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in spite of the war clashed with those of Sharp and his unit, who felt that they did what was necessary to get the job done, regardless of moralizing.

As his unit specialized in demolitions, Sharp and his men accompanied Generals Fisto and Koon to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] climate-control base which was preventing Republic forces in orbit from sending reinforcements. Along the way, they were ambushed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a unit of droids, wiping out most of Sharp's men and the explosives they had brought. General Koon came up with an alternate plan, however, to slice into the weather station's controls and aim a storm on the station itself. Sharp had his electronics specialist [[Fixer (clone trooper)|Fixer]] do so, directing a storm at the station and destroying it.

With the weather station out of the way, the main Separatist base could be attacked. While Plo Koon led a group to free a group of [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] hostages within the base, Sharp accompanied General Fisto into the base to destroy the base's main defense guns. Entering through the large turret's barrel, Fisto and Sharp were able to enter the base though without an immediate plan to sabotage or destroy the guns before more droids arrived. Sharp came up with idea to use the gun's [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]]-fueled round to destroy the other cannons. He chose to personally ignite the round himself, sacrificing himself to knock out the guns while giving Fisto enough time to escape. He explained to the general that he wanted to go out like a Devil Dog - with a bang. The plan succeeded and the guns, as well as most of the base, were destroyed.
